top_choice_rationale: P002 rewards the one discovery on the slate that is a new state of matter: the Z2 topological insulator and quantum spin Hall state, predicted by Kane and Mele and first observed by Molenkamp in HgTe/CdTe wells, then independently confirmed by transport, ARPES, STM and first-principles calculations. The attribution gap (Bernevig, Hughes and Zhang) is real and bounded by a citation anchored on the Z2 state and its first observation. P001 is a close second, with cleaner credit but more of a precision gain; P003 is outside my field and has the narrowest support and unconfirmed point sources; no award is ranked last because the slate contains mature, verified discoveries.
